description: Complete redesign of the landing page with premium glassmorphism aesthetic, 3D floating elements, animated background orbs, and emerald/teal accents. Covers Navbar, Hero, Features, Pricing, Footer, and adds a Testimonials section.
steps: Rewrite components/landing/Navbar.tsx: Glass navbar with bg-white/5 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-white/10. Logo text should use bg-gradient-to-r from-emerald-400 to-teal-400 bg-clip-text text-transparent. Nav links: text-gray-400 hover:text-white. CTA buttons: primary uses emerald gradient, sign-in uses ghost glass style. Mobile menu also glass-styled. Remove all light mode classes (bg-white, text-gray-600 etc).

Rewrite components/landing/Hero.tsx: Dark background with animated gradient orbs (2-3 large blurred circles with emerald/teal colors using the 'blob' animation class from globals.css, position:absolute with different animation-delays). Large bold headline with 'Ship Faster.' part using bg-gradient-to-r from-emerald-400 to-teal-400 bg-clip-text text-transparent. Subtitle in gray-400. CTA buttons: primary emerald gradient, secondary glass outline. Below the text, add a floating glass card 'mockup' showing a simplified dashboard preview (just a styled div with glass bg, some placeholder stat numbers, representing the product). Apply perspective and rotateX/rotateY transforms to the mockup for 3D depth feel. Add floating pill badges around the hero (e.g., 'GDPR', 'SOC2', 'HIPAA') with glass styling and subtle shadow, positioned absolutely with float animation.

Rewrite components/landing/Features.tsx: Section with dark bg. Header text white with emerald gradient accent word. Feature cards use glass styling (bg-white/5 backdrop-blur-xl border-white/10 rounded-2xl p-6). On hover: border-emerald-500/30, transform scale slightly, shadow-lg shadow-emerald-500/10. Icon containers: bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-400 rounded-xl. Use group/group-hover for the tilt-card hover effect. Keep existing feature data but update all colors to remove light mode references.

Rewrite components/landing/Pricing.tsx: Glass pricing cards. Featured/popular card gets border-emerald-500/50 with shadow-xl shadow-emerald-500/20 and a subtle emerald glow. Other cards: standard glass bg-white/5 border-white/10. Badge for 'Most Popular' uses emerald gradient bg. Price numbers in white, large and bold. Feature checkmarks in emerald-400. CTA buttons: featured card gets emerald gradient primary button, others get glass outline. Remove all light mode classes. Keep the scale-105 on featured card.

Create a new Testimonials section. Add a new file components/landing/Testimonials.tsx: Glass cards with placeholder quotes from fictional users (3 testimonials). Each card: glass bg, quote text in gray-300, author name in white, role in gray-500. Stars or quote icon in emerald-400. Layout: grid of 3 columns on desktop, stacked on mobile. Section header with emerald gradient accent.
Update app/page.tsx to import and include the Testimonials component between Pricing and Footer.

Rewrite components/landing/Footer.tsx: Glass footer with bg-white/5 backdrop-blur-xl border-t border-white/10. Logo in emerald gradient text. Link text gray-400 hover:text-emerald-400 transition. Divider line border-white/5. Copyright text gray-500. Remove all light mode styles.
acceptance_criteria: Navbar uses glass styling with emerald gradient logo
Hero has animated background orbs with blob/float CSS animations
Hero has floating pill badges with glass styling
Hero has a 3D glass card mockup with perspective transforms
Features cards use glass bg-white/5 with hover glow effects
Pricing featured card has emerald glow border
New Testimonials component exists and is rendered on landing page
Footer uses glass styling with emerald accents
No light mode classes remain in landing components (no bg-white, no text-gray-900 without dark: prefix, no from-gray-50)
npm run build succeeds without errors
verification: Run npm run build in /projects/sandbox/notherobrinesmplol and confirm exit code 0
findings: Build passes cleanly. All landing components rewritten to dark-only glassmorphism. Testimonials section added between Pricing and Footer. Hero uses inline style attributes for animation delays since Tailwind doesn't support animation-delay out of the box. 3D mockup uses inline perspective/transform styles.
